description: This PHP class 'Each' validates that all elements in an iterable (like an array) satisfy a specific rule, implementing a validation pattern within the OrangeHRM project's validation framework.

classes.name: Each
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if every element in an iterable satisfies a given rule.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that takes a validation rule implementing AbstractComposite.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that all elements of the input iterable satisfy the rule; throws an error or returns false if validation fails.
